tasks.label: validate-ai-endpoints
args: (async()=>{const axios=require('axios'); const FormData=require('form-data'); const fs=require('fs'); try{let form=new FormData(); form.append('resume', fs.createReadStream('sample.pdf')); let r=await axios.post('http://localhost:3000/api/ai/resume-review', form,{headers:{...form.getHeaders(),'x-dev-bypass':'true','x-dev-user-id':'devtest'}}); console.log('resume-review', r.status, JSON.stringify(r.data)); form=new FormData(); form.append('topic','AI in public health'); form.append('requirements','Include methodology and conclusion'); form.append('citationStyle','APA'); form.append('files', Buffer.from('This is a source note about AI in healthcare.'), {filename:'notes.txt', contentType:'text/plain'}); r=await axios.post('http://localhost:3000/api/ai/generate-research-paper', form,{headers:{...form.getHeaders(),'x-dev-bypass':'true','x-dev-user-id':'devtest'}}); console.log('research-paper', r.status, JSON.stringify(r.data)); r=await axios.post('http://localhost:3000/api/ai/generate-image',{prompt:'A futuristic AI healthcare illustration',publish:false},{headers:{'x-dev-bypass':'true','x-dev-user-id':'devtest'}}); console.log('generate-image', r.status, JSON.stringify(r.data)); }catch(e){console.error('ERR', e.response?JSON.stringify(e.response.data):e.message); process.exitCode=1;} })()
